postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip(test_lengths, test_strings))
postconditions.description: Each binary string S has a length equal to the corresponding value in test_lengths.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10^5 for n in test_lengths)
postconditions.description: The length of each binary string S is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of test cases T is between 1 and 4000, inclusive.
The sum of the lengths of all binary strings across all test cases does not exceed 10^5.
